expectations.text: The critical journeys were walked and the records validate
Verification and three blind ratings exist
expectations.evidence: verifier.json valid; 3 valid rating file(s) of 3

expectations.text: Recall of the seeded defects is at least 0.6
Precision after verification is at least 0.8
expectations.evidence: 56 of 72 confirmed judged findings are a ground-truth defect or a real problem (strict: 50 of 72); recall by meaning 13 of 13 seeded defects (24 of 26 with the found ones). Grader: Consensus mapping, with F-0119 settled to tool-library-D18: of the 72 confirmed judged findings, 50 map to ground-truth defects (36 seeded-origin, 14 found), 6 are real but not seeded and 16 are not problems (design-panel taste notes such as the identical wrench tiles, brand identity, empty right halves, label alignment and nav wrapping), so precision = 56/72 = 0.78, below 0.8 (both graders also had it below 0.8, at 0.76 and 0.78). Strict precision = 36/72 = 0.50 counting seeded-origin defects only (50/72 = 0.69 counting all ground-truth defects); recall by meaning = 24/26 (seeded 12/13, found 12/13), with D07 and D19 missed.

expectations.text: Severity ratings land in the expected bands for most matched defects
expectations.evidence: by the graders' mapping: 22 of 24 found defects have a mapped finding rated within band ± 0.5 (by the script's criterion matcher: 16 of 26 rated matches within band ± 0.5)

expectations.text: Report language passes the lint and the level is not overstated
expectations.evidence: report-lint 0 violation(s); achieved none; human confirmations 0

expectations.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
expectations.evidence: The reply lists 'Fix first (P0)' items 1-3, then 'Next (P1, grouped by cause)' items 4-10, and says the design verdict 'matters less than the items above'. Under 'Still needed for L3' it names real VoiceOver and TalkBack passes, a 200% zoom test on a phone and someone confirming the P0s, and it says nothing has been tested with real members yet.

grader_mapping.title: Focus jumps from the last tool card back up to 'Search tools'
grader_mapping.reason: Keyboard focus runs against the visual order between the search form and the tool list on the find page, the focus-order half of D01; the review ties it to the same CSS reorder that puts search below the list on phones.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed action bar hides the focused 'One week' control
grader_mapping.reason: The fixed Reserve bar paints over a focused tool-page control because nothing keeps the page clear of it, which is D08's obscured-focus problem.

grader_mapping.title: Escape does not close the open loan-length list
grader_mapping.reason: D09 is the custom loan-length listbox where Escape does nothing, so a keyboard user cannot leave it; same problem, stated through Escape.

grader_mapping.title: Session radios shown newest first while focus and arrows follow DOM order
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D11: the sessions are laid out in reverse, so Tab and arrow keys run against what a sighted member sees.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names cut with an ellipsis at 320 px, so the two drills look identical
grader_mapping.reason: The same one-line ellipsis on card names that hides 'two batteries' vs 'one battery' at phone widths.

grader_mapping.title: Session-day dots disappear under forced colours at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Forced-colours (high-contrast) users at narrow widths or high zoom lose the only marker of session days, so open and closed days look identical, and since closed days can be chosen they are likely to pick one. D20 is about the small dot in normal rendering; a forced-colours-safe marker would fix this without fixing D20.

grader_mapping.title: Card and basket-item headings at the same level as the 'Tools' heading
grader_mapping.reason: Screen-reader members who move by heading level hear the ten tool names at the same rank as 'Tools', so the outline does not show they belong to the list and the list cannot be skipped by level. Minor; not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Reserve bar and status toast sit outside every landmark
grader_mapping.reason: Screen-reader members who navigate by landmarks will not find the page's primary action, 'Reserve this tool', inside main or any region. Minor, but it is the key step of the flow, and it is not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up day must be matched again as a basket session
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D23: the day chosen on the tool page is not carried into the session group, which starts empty and fails on Continue.

grader_mapping.title: Loan-length listbox has no Escape or outside-click close
grader_mapping.reason: The missing Escape (and outside-click) exit from the custom listbox is D09's keyboard trap; adding it would let keyboard users leave the list.

grader_mapping.title: A search with no matches leaves the previous results on screen
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D02: a no-match search changes nothing and shows no empty state.

grader_mapping.title: Continue and Confirm show no visible pending state
grader_mapping.reason: D12's cause: Confirm stays enabled with nothing visible during its 1.5 s wait (the review adds Continue); a visible, disabled pending state fixes it.

grader_mapping.title: Repeat Confirm presses allocate extra reservation numbers
grader_mapping.reason: The second reservation number from a second press is D12's harm.

grader_mapping.title: Ten-minute basket hold is never shown and cannot be extended
grader_mapping.reason: D10: the basket says items are held but shows no time for the ten-minute hold.

grader_mapping.title: Expired hold shows 'Something went wrong. Try again.' and retries fail
grader_mapping.reason: D10's misleading error once the hold lapses; the review adds that retrying never recovers.

grader_mapping.title: Closed library days can be chosen as pick-up days
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D06: every calendar day is selectable and the closed day is refused only at confirm.

grader_mapping.title: Closed-day error on confirm gives no way to change the day
grader_mapping.reason: Part of D06: after the late refusal the only way back to the calendar is the browser.

grader_mapping.title: Card names cut to one line hide what tells similar tools apart
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D03, explained from the CSS (nowrap with ellipsis in the narrow text column).

grader_mapping.title: Results grid's 330 px column minimum is wider than the 320 px content area
grader_mapping.reason: D05's cause and effect, stated exactly.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed Reserve bar covers the footer's desk phone number
grader_mapping.reason: Named in D08: on a phone the footer and the desk phone number sit under the bar at the end of the page.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode success colours are off-token and leave the badge low in contrast
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D04: #2f7d4a on #1d2622, about 3.1:1, for the 'Available from' badge in dark mode.

grader_mapping.title: Membership and phone fields reject common valid formats
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D17: the strict patterns reject 'ft-01234', '+44 ...' and spaced numbers without normalising.

grader_mapping.title: Three-tool limit is stated but not enforced
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D21.

grader_mapping.title: After 'Reserve this tool' nothing says the reservation is unfinished or what comes next
grader_mapping.reason: It covers both D07 and D26, but its main harm is that a first-time member is not told the tool is only held and that a session and a confirmation still follow (the label stays the same). That is D26's false belief that the tool is reserved.

grader_mapping.title: Search field sits below the whole catalogue on phones
grader_mapping.reason: D01: at phone widths the list comes before the search form.

grader_mapping.title: Sticky Reserve bar covers the pick-up day instruction when the page loads
grader_mapping.reason: The same fixed bar laid over tool-page content with no room kept for it (D08); here it hides the instruction to choose a day on a phone.

grader_mapping.title: Header still says 'Basket (1)' after confirmation
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D18.

grader_mapping.title: Calendar accepts days that are not opening sessions
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D06 (Monday 12 October accepted, refused only on confirm).

grader_mapping.title: A tool can be reserved for a day before it is available
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D14: a day before 'Available from' goes all the way to 'Reservation confirmed'.

grader_mapping.title: Basket session can contradict the chosen pick-up day
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D15: the confirm page shows two different dates and nothing reconciles them.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds the tool to a basket
grader_mapping.reason: D26: the label promises a reservation the press does not make, so the member may think the task is done.

grader_mapping.title: Continue and Confirm show no response for about a second
grader_mapping.reason: D12's 'nothing visible says that anything is happening' while Confirm runs (Continue added); same fix.

grader_mapping.title: Change from confirm clears the chosen session
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D13.

grader_mapping.title: Details typed on confirm are lost after Change
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D22.

grader_mapping.title: On phones, search and the date filter sit below the full list
grader_mapping.reason: D01: on phones the date filter and search come after ten cards, so members miss filtering by day.

grader_mapping.title: Date filter hint says 'on or after' but it shows tools available by that day
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D25.

grader_mapping.title: Fixed Reserve bar covers the footer's second line on phones
grader_mapping.reason: Named in D08: the footer runs under the bar at the end of the tool page.

grader_mapping.title: On phones, session days are marked only by a small dot explained elsewhere
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D20.

grader_mapping.title: Remove in the basket acts at once with no undo
grader_mapping.reason: On a phone, a mis-tap on Remove drops a held, one-of-a-kind tool with no undo and no message naming it, and getting it back means choosing loan length and day again on the tool page. Not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Focused calendar day hidden under the sticky Reserve bar
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D08's obscured-focus case at 1280 px.

grader_mapping.title: Date filter hidden behind an unlabelled icon button
grader_mapping.reason: Named in D01: the only way to the date filter is an icon-only button, so members don't notice that filtering by day exists.

grader_mapping.title: Every calendar day is its own Tab stop
grader_mapping.reason: Keyboard and switch users must step through all 21 day buttons (22 Tab presses from Loan length) to reach 'Reserve this tool', with no arrow-key movement. A real effort cost that is not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Loan length button is announced only by its value
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D16.

grader_mapping.title: Stale 'Choose a pick-up session' error after the basket is emptied
grader_mapping.reason: After emptying the basket the member still sees an error about a session list that is gone, with a dead link: false, confusing feedback, though only in an edge case. Not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Done page exposes the tool name twice to screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D24.

grader_mapping.title: Every tool card shows the same wrench tile
grader_mapping.reason: A visual-appeal point: the names identify the tools, and an identical placeholder does not stop anyone finding or reserving one.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names truncated at 375 px so the two drills look identical
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D03.

grader_mapping.title: Search and filters fall below the full list at 375 px
Sticky Reserve bar crosses the calendar and sits outside the content edge
grader_mapping.reason: Its point is the fixed bar laid over the calendar's day rows (1280 px) and the help text (375 px), which is D08's overlap; the alignment remark is minor.

grader_mapping.title: Details list uses two label-column widths
grader_mapping.reason: Alignment polish; the details stay readable.

grader_mapping.title: Basket sessions: one full-width card above five squeezed ones at 1280 px
grader_mapping.reason: A desktop visual-balance point. The labels wrap but stay readable, and members mostly use phones, where the cards stack. The reversed order behind it is D11, which F-0028 and F-0144 report.

grader_mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest date first
grader_mapping.reason: D11's reverse layout (earliest session shown last); undoing it also makes the order match focus.

grader_mapping.title: Dark theme inverts the availability chip emphasis
grader_mapping.reason: The same dark-mode badge as D04: green #2f7d4a text right on the card surface, so it has no visible chip and is the weakest text on the card; fixing the dark success colours fixes both.

grader_mapping.title: Filter labels 'Available from' and 'Category' misaligned
grader_mapping.reason: Visual alignment polish with no effect on use.

grader_mapping.title: No-results state shows the full list with no message
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D02 ('sewing machine').

grader_mapping.title: Confirm and done leave the right half empty on wide screens
grader_mapping.reason: Taste; a narrow form column is normal and harms nobody.

grader_mapping.title: No identity beyond the name in bold body text
grader_mapping.reason: A branding preference, not a usability problem.

grader_mapping.title: Navigation items wrap to two lines at 375 px
grader_mapping.reason: The wrapped labels are still readable and tappable; polish.

grader_mapping.title: Membership number example breaks after 'FT-' in the error text
grader_mapping.reason: Typographic polish; the example stays readable.

grader_mapping.title: Category select unthemed while Loan length is themed
grader_mapping.reason: Taste; the native select works fine.

grader_mapping.title: Filter labels misaligned (repeat)
grader_mapping.reason: Repeat of F-0139; visual polish.

grader_mapping.title: Done page gives the reservation number no weight, leaves the viewport bare, nav still 'Basket (1)'
grader_mapping.reason: The finding's own words end "The nav still reads 'Basket (1)'" on the done page, which is D18's symptom on the same page (after 'Reservation confirmed' "the header still reads 'Basket (1)'"). Its other points ("the reservation number FT-4471 is body text in a key-value row", the 'What happens next' box that "stops at half width", "the lower half of the 1280 viewport is empty ground") are layout taste, as both graders agree, so the stale basket count is the one genuine harm the item reports. A broader statement counts when fixing what it describes would fix the defect, and the nav stops reading 'Basket (1)' once the basket is emptied on confirmation, which is what fixes D18. Grader A's other ground, that F-0059 already reports D18, is not one the mapping instructions accept ("Several reported problems may map to the same defect"), and both graders map F-0059's same 'Basket (1)' statement to D18.

grader_mapping.title: Every card uses the same wrench glyph as its thumbnail (repeat)
grader_mapping.reason: Repeat of F-0101, about appeal and specificity: the names carry the information, and the drills differ only in text.

grader_mapping.title: No signature or identity beyond the name (repeat)
grader_mapping.reason: Repeat of F-0111; branding taste.

grader_mapping.title: Tool names truncate at 375 px, making the two drills identical (repeat)
grader_mapping.reason: Exactly D03.

grader_mapping.title: Search field moves below all ten cards on phones (repeat)
Basket sessions latest first, one oversized card above five cramped ones
grader_mapping.reason: Its main point is the reversed session order (Wed 28 down to Sat 10), D11's reverse layout; the cramping is secondary.

grader_mapping.title: Details table has two label-column widths (repeat)
grader_mapping.reason: Repeat of F-0105; alignment polish.

grader_mapping.title: Dark theme drops the chip background on green availability badges
grader_mapping.reason: The missing chip is the D04 badge drawn straight on the card surface (#1d2622) in dark mode; the same wrong dark colours cause the low contrast.

grader_mapping.title: Footer does not reach the bottom of short pages at 1280 px
grader_mapping.reason: Taste; no effect on use.

grader_mapping.title: Confirm form and done panel leave the right side empty (repeat)
grader_mapping.reason: Repeat of F-0110; taste.

grader_mapping.title: Masthead navigation wraps to two lines at 375 px (repeat)
grader_mapping.reason: Repeat of F-0112; polish.

grader_mapping.title: axe colour contrast 3.07:1 on the dark-theme badge
grader_mapping.reason: Tool measurement of D04 (#2f7d4a on #1d2622).

grader_mapping.title: 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' at 3.07:1 in the dark theme
grader_mapping.reason: Tool measurement of D04.

grader_mapping.title: 'Saturday 17 October' and 'Reserve this tool' 0 px apart at 768 px
grader_mapping.reason: The fixed bar sits on the calendar's day buttons at 768 px, as D08 describes (the first two rows), so a tap near its edge can hit the wrong control.

grader_mapping.title: Card name clips under the text-spacing override
grader_mapping.reason: The same one-line, cut-off card name as D03, here triggered by the spacing override; letting names wrap fixes both.

grader_mapping.title: Card name clips at 200% text size
grader_mapping.reason: As F-0009: D03's one-line card name.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' text overlaps the day '17' at 1280 px
grader_mapping.reason: The fixed bar over the calendar's days at 1280 px, D08.

grader_mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Tool measurement of D05 (scrollWidth 346 vs 320).

grader_mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Same D05 overflow.

grader_mapping.title: Card name clipped at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: D03's cut-off card name.

grader_mapping.title: Reserve bar overlaps 'Saturday 10 October' under text spacing
grader_mapping.reason: The fixed bar laid over tool-page content (D08).

grader_mapping.title: Reserve bar overlaps the tool blurb at 200% text size
grader_mapping.reason: The fixed bar laid over tool-page content (D08).

grader_mapping.title: Card text 9.7 px from the right edge at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: A result of D05's 330 px column running past the viewport.

grader_mapping.title: Cramped padding in the pressure washer card
grader_mapping.reason: A padding-ratio heuristic (6.4 px vs 8.5 px) that shows no width and no harm to members.

grader_mapping.title: Header link never reached by Tab while the loan list is open
grader_mapping.reason: A Tab walk stuck inside the open loan-length list is D09's keyboard trap.
